{{Top|leg}}
'''Dorumaa Base''' was a base on [[Dorumaa]] that was ran by the [[Thaereian military]]. The base was located on the opposite side of Dorumaa to the resorts and cities and was in a remote place. The base contained a various buildings, including a hangar and three shield emitter towers. It was surrounded by a defensive ditch.<ref name="LF">{{LivingForce|Decision: Cularin}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Blockade of the Cularin system]], the base was the Thaereian military's last ground base in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It was commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vayla Sevren]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] supplied [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to help defend it. It was attacked by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Battle of Dorumaa]] and they destroyed the shield emitter towers and captured the base.<ref name="LF" />
